## What's new: your agent sees Radiant better, and you can read what it did

- **Ids it reads right.** The ids on a map view are larger and plainer, and no longer written over a wall for what stands behind it.
- **Every menu entry.** Your agent reaches all of Radiant's menu entries, those whose name holds a `/` included (Select by Key/Value, Convert Probe to/from Box).
- **The craft, from the command line too.** Each map command's help gives every argument and points to the mapping skill, and `map find --near` finds a brush by where it is.
- **A sleeping screen no longer blinds it.** A view turns your screen back on instead of coming back blank.
- **A journal of what it did.** Set `T7KB_DEBUG` and t7kb records each command and tool call, what it answered and the images it saw ([how](https://github.com/McReaper/t7_companion/blob/main/docs/cli.md)).
- **Radiant bridge 1.2.2** ships with it. If Radiant is already open with an older bridge, close and reopen it to get the entries with a `/`.
